name: The Cost of a Crown: A Story of Douay and Durham
name_pt: O Preço de uma Coroa: História de Douai e Durham
desc: Benson's sacred drama of 1910, written for the boys of St Edmund's College, Ware, about the martyrs of the English College at Douai and the persecution in Durham: a prologue and three acts.
desc_pt: O drama sacro de Benson (1910), escrito para os alunos do St Edmund's College, Ware, sobre os mártires do Colégio Inglês de Douai e a perseguição em Durham: um prólogo e três atos.
edition: The Cost of a Crown: A Story of Douay and Durham (London: Longmans, Green, 1910), Internet Archive full-text OCR (cu31924013587989).
